title: Algerian Pan-Seared Paneer Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful North African-inspired dish featuring tender paneer and a sweet and spicy tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chilies, garlic, and onion, and cook until onion is translucent.
Add the tomatoes, almonds, cumin, and paprika. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the paneer, and cook until golden brown.
Stir in lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.
Cook the almonds in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly toasted.
Stir the toasted almonds into the tagine sauce before serving.
Cook the tagine sauce for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened and flavorful.
Serve the tagine sauce over the paneer, and garnish with fresh herbs.
Cook the paneer in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and tender.
Stir the tagine sauce into the cooked paneer, and season with salt and pepper.
